title: Admin Login Authentication Bypass via SQL Injection
impact: An attacker may bypass authentication and gain unauthorized access to the administrator account without knowing the valid credentials.
remediation: Use parameterized queries and prepared statements, validate user inputs, and implement secure authentication practices.

title: UNION-Based SQL Injection – Data Extraction
impact: Unauthorized extraction of user information, including email addresses, through the product search API.
remediation: Use parameterized queries, validate inputs, and apply least-privilege database permissions.

title: Reflected Cross-Site Scripting
impact: An attacker may execute JavaScript in a victim's browser through a crafted URL.
remediation: Encode output according to context, sanitize untrusted HTML, and use a Content Security Policy.

title: Stored Cross-Site Scripting
impact: An attacker may store malicious content that executes when other users view the saved feedback.
remediation: Sanitize untrusted HTML using an up-to-date library, encode output, and use a Content Security Policy.
